task.description: Write tests/specs/EXP-701.md. EXP-701 is document-only so tests are static validation checks: (1) file exists and is non-empty; (2) all 7 required sections present; (3) go-live checklist contains at least 20 items; (4) cross-reference exists in the architecture doc. These can be implemented as a Zig unit test that reads the file at compile-time with @embedFile or at runtime with std.fs. No DB required.

result.summary: REWORK 1 completed for EXP-701: spec explicitly separates non-automatable human sign-off from automated checks; unit test now validates all five technical acceptance criteria sections and conditionally checks release gate status artifact existence.

issues.description: Human reviewed/signed-off state is non-automatable by design; technical acceptance is fully covered in unit tests, and human attestation is recorded in docs/status/release-exp701-20260614.yaml during release validation.
